content: this is a summary of a civil case that took place in the telšiai district court the court proceedings occurred on october 27 2023 the case involved a divorce between two parties referred to as the applicant and the defendant the court has made a final decision regarding the division of matrimonial property the applicant has been awarded a ½ share of the apartment and personal property while the defendant has also been awarded a ½ share of the apartment and personal property both parties are still jointly and severally liable for the lease agreement and surety agreement the applicant is responsible for using and meeting the credit obligations for a toyota corolla car with their own funds additionally the applicant must pay the defendant compensation for a greater share of the property possession the court has considered various articles from the civil code related to matrimonial property the court has also discussed the costs of the case including stamp duty and professional fees the court has awarded costs to the claimant for the part of the claim that was upheld and to the defendant for the part of the claim that was rejected the court has considered the conduct of the parties and the reasons for the costs in determining the allocation the court has ordered the defendant to pay stamp duty to the state overall the court has partially granted the applicants claims and has ordered the payment of various amounts to both parties
